reference_implementation_only.explanation: Lua math.random(100) draws integers 1 through 100. The drop callbacks compare strictly below their configured thresholds. The same-species branch uses <=15 conditional on a successful core roll. Otherwise they choose a monster in the same Bestiary race, without filtering occurrence rarity. The two pinned implementations are byte-identical, so they do not provide independent corroboration of Global probabilities.
reference_implementation_only.loot_bonus_interaction: Core/prism rolls are separate from ordinary loot-table probabilities. The resulting guaranteed drops still use the ordinary retained corpse mint path.

forge_classification.implementation_note: Channel runtime refreshes a bounded population at 270-second intervals. This is not an exact per-death replacement timer; no Global scheduler parity is claimed.

official_sources.supports: Fiendish acquisition, predominantly the killed species and rare additional cores of uncommon, rare or very rare species in the same Bestiary class.
official_sources.limitation: Indexed official description has no numeric probability. Direct retrieval returned HTTP 403. The reference implementation instead selects mutually exclusive same-species or same-race branches.

official_sources.supports: Prism drops, next-higher-difficulty transformations and random two-core fusion.
official_sources.limitation: No numeric probability or exact fusion distribution.
The inspected creature response schema has loot names, but no numeric soul-core probabilities or fiendish/Soulpit endpoint.

runtime_gap.limitations: Classification population/lifetime/replacement and numeric acquisition probabilities are reference fallback values, not verified against Global. Existing loot-plan and corpse capacity refusals remain enforced.

decision: Owner decision 22: adopt pinned Canary/Crystal executed probabilities as fallback, explicitly not verified against Global. Live Channel Forge classification is captured before lethal settlement and retained in the ordinary corpse plan.

global_observations.supports: Approximate 15-20% own-species chance; rare additional uncommon/rare/very-rare same-class core. Conflicts with pinned mutually-exclusive branches; approximate numbers are not exact qualification.
Prism next-higher difficulty with highest-difficulty clamp, and fusion produces any Bestiary difficulty.
